105:         this.storage.zip(other.storage).forall { case (a, b) => a == b }

161: /** Tokenizer for string and bytes-like input values. */
162: class StringTokenizer(
163:     encoding: String = StandardCharsets.UTF_8.name(),
164:     normalizer: Option[String => String] = None
165: ) extends BaseTokenizer[Any] {
166: 
167:   private val charset: Charset       = Charset.forName(encoding)
168:   private val norm: String => String = normalizer.getOrElse(identity)
169: 
170:   override def tokenize(value: Any): Token = value match {
171:     case s: String      => Token(norm(s), TokenType.STRING)
172:     case b: Array[Byte] => Token(norm(new String(b, charset)), TokenType.STRING)
173:     case other          =>
174:       throw new IllegalArgumentException(
175:         s"StringTokenizer cannot tokenize value of type ${other.getClass.getName}"
176:       )
177:   }

184: /**
185:  * Tokenizer for numeric types (Int, Long, Float, Double, BigDecimal, java.math.BigDecimal).
186:  *
187:  * Note: the Python original uses a mutable default for `format_options`. Scala
188:  * does not have that pitfall; the default is a stable immutable empty map.
189:  */
190: class NumericTokenizer(
191:     precision: Int = 6,
192:     formatOptions: Map[String, Any] = Map.empty
193: ) extends BaseTokenizer[Any] {
194: 
195:   private val p: Int = math.max(0, precision)
196: 
197:   override def tokenize(value: Any): Token = value match {
198:     case d: BigDecimal =>
199:       Token(formatDecimal(d, p), TokenType.NUMERIC, Map("original_type" -> "Decimal"))
200:     case d: java.math.BigDecimal =>
201:       Token(formatDecimal(BigDecimal(d.toString), p), TokenType.NUMERIC, Map("original_type" -> "Decimal"))
202:     case d: Double =>
203:       Token(formatDecimal(BigDecimal(d), p), TokenType.NUMERIC, Map("original_type" -> "float"))
204:     case f: Float =>
205:       Token(formatDecimal(BigDecimal(f.toDouble), p), TokenType.NUMERIC, Map("original_type" -> "float"))
206:     case n: Short =>
207:       Token(n.toString, TokenType.NUMERIC, Map("original_type" -> "int"))
208:     case n: Byte =>
209:       Token(n.toString, TokenType.NUMERIC, Map("original_type" -> "int"))
210:     case n: Int =>
211:       Token(n.toString, TokenType.NUMERIC, Map("original_type" -> "int"))
212:     case n: Long =>
213:       Token(n.toString, TokenType.NUMERIC, Map("original_type" -> "int"))
214:     case n: Number =>
215:       Token(n.toString, TokenType.NUMERIC, Map("original_type" -> n.getClass.getSimpleName))
216:     case other =>
217:       throw new IllegalArgumentException(
218:         s"NumericTokenizer cannot tokenize value of type ${other.getClass.getName}"
219:       )
220:   }
221: 
222:   private def formatDecimal(d: BigDecimal, precision: Int): String = {
223:     if (precision == 0) d.setScale(0, BigDecimal.RoundingMode.HALF_UP).toString
224:     else d.setScale(precision, BigDecimal.RoundingMode.HALF_UP).toString
225:   }

232: /** Tokenizer for date / date-time types using `java.time`. */
233: class TemporalTokenizer(formatStr: Option[String] = None) extends BaseTokenizer[Any] {
234: 
235:   import TemporalTokenizer._
236: 
237:   override def tokenize(value: Any): Token = {
238:     val fmt: DateTimeFormatter = formatStr match {
239:       case Some(pattern) => DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern(pattern)
240:       case None          =>
241:         value match {
242:           case _: LocalDateTime => ISO_FORMAT
243:           case _: LocalDate     => DATE_FORMAT
244:           case _                => ISO_FORMAT
245:         }
246:     }

248:     val rendered: String = value match {
249:       case dt: LocalDateTime => dt.format(fmt)
250:       case d: LocalDate      => d.format(fmt)
251:       case other             =>
252:         throw new IllegalArgumentException(
253:           s"TemporalTokenizer cannot tokenize value of type ${other.getClass.getName}"
254:         )

270: /** Tokenizer that dispatches at runtime to the correct specialized tokenizer. */
271: class UniversalTokenizer {
272:   private val stringTokenizer   = new StringTokenizer()
273:   private val numericTokenizer  = new NumericTokenizer()
274:   private val temporalTokenizer = new TemporalTokenizer()
275: 
276:   /** Convert a value of arbitrary type into a Token. */
277:   def tokenize(value: Any): Token = value match {
278:     case null                  => Token("NULL", TokenType.NULL)
279:     case t: Tokenizable        => Token(t.toToken, TokenType.STRUCTURED)
280:     case _: String             => stringTokenizer.tokenize(value)
281:     case _: Array[Byte]        => stringTokenizer.tokenize(value)
282:     case _: Number             => numericTokenizer.tokenize(value)
283:     case _: LocalDateTime      => temporalTokenizer.tokenize(value)
284:     case _: LocalDate          => temporalTokenizer.tokenize(value)
285:     case other                 =>
286:       Token(other.toString, TokenType.STRING, Map("fallback" -> true))
287:   }
288: 
289:   /** Explicit token for a null/missing value. */
290:   def tokenizeNull: Token = Token("NULL", TokenType.NULL)
291: 
292:   /** Convert an iterable of arbitrary values into tokens. */
293:   def tokenizeBatch(values: Iterable[Any]): List[Token] =
294:     values.iterator.map(tokenize).toList
295: 
296:   /** Lazy stream variant. */
297:   def tokenizeStream(values: Iterable[Any]): LazyList[Token] =
298:     values.to(LazyList).map(tokenize)

305: /** Registry of `TokenContainer`s keyed by name, plus a stack of optional producers. */
306: final class TokenRegistry[T] {
307:   private val registry = mutable.Map.empty[String, TokenContainer[T]]
308:   private val handlers = mutable.ListBuffer.empty[T => Option[Token]]
309: 
310:   def register(key: String, container: TokenContainer[T]): Unit = {
311:     registry(key) = container
312:   }
313: 
314:   def addHandler(handler: T => Option[Token]): Unit = {
315:     handlers += handler
316:   }
317: 
318:   /**
319:    * Apply handlers in order to every item in the registered container. The
320:    * first handler that returns Some is used; otherwise None is recorded.
321:    */
322:   def process(key: String): List[Option[Token]] = registry.get(key) match {
323:     case None       => Nil
324:     case Some(cont) =>
325:       cont.getAll.iterator.map { item =>
326:         handlers.iterator.flatMap(_.apply(item)).take(1).toList.headOption
327:       }.toList

335: /** Minimal functor wrapper - Scala cannot model true HKTs at the value level
336:  *  but can express the same semantics on a single concrete type. */
337: class TokenFunctor[T](val value: T) {
338:   def map[U](f: T => U): TokenFunctor[U] = new TokenFunctor(f(value))

345:     if (value == null) default else value

352:     TokenMonad.pure(fWrapped.value.apply(value))

363: /** Recursive JSON value type - modelled as a sealed trait hierarchy. */
364: sealed trait JsonValue

366: object JsonValue {
367:   case class JString(s: String)                       extends JsonValue
368:   case class JNumber(n: BigDecimal)                   extends JsonValue
369:   case class JBool(b: Boolean)                        extends JsonValue
370:   case object JNull                                  extends JsonValue
371:   case class JArray(items: List[JsonValue])           extends JsonValue
372:   case class JObject(fields: Map[String, JsonValue])  extends JsonValue
373: 
374:   /** Convert an arbitrary Scala/Java value into a [[JsonValue]] tree. */
375:   def fromAny(a: Any): JsonValue = a match {
376:     case null              => JNull
377:     case s: String         => JString(s)
378:     case b: Boolean        => JBool(b)
379:     case n: Int            => JNumber(BigDecimal(n))
380:     case n: Long           => JNumber(BigDecimal(n))
381:     case n: Short          => JNumber(BigDecimal(n.toInt))
382:     case n: Byte           => JNumber(BigDecimal(n.toInt))
383:     case n: Double         => JNumber(BigDecimal(n))
384:     case n: Float          => JNumber(BigDecimal(n.toDouble))
385:     case n: BigDecimal     => JNumber(n)
386:     case m: Map[_, _]      =>
387:       JObject(m.iterator.map { case (k, v) => k.toString -> fromAny(v) }.toMap)
388:     case xs: Iterable[_]   => JArray(xs.iterator.map(fromAny).toList)
389:     case other             => JString(other.toString)
390:   }
391: 
392:   /** Convert a [[io.circe.Json]] tree into a [[JsonValue]]. */
393:   def fromCirce(json: CirceJson): JsonValue = json.fold(
394:     JNull,
395:     JBool.apply,
396:     n => JNumber(BigDecimal(n.toString)),
397:     s => JString(s),
398:     arr => JArray(arr.toList.map(fromCirce)),
399:     obj => JObject(obj.toMap.map { case (k, v) => k -> fromCirce(v) })
400:   )
401: }

403: /** Tokenizer for JSON values, including dotted-path extraction. */
404: class JsonTokenizer(pretty: Boolean = false) {
405: 
406:   /** Convert a [[JsonValue]] to a [[Token]] whose value is a JSON string. */
407:   def tokenize(value: JsonValue): Token = {
408:     val rendered = JsonTokenizer.render(value, pretty)
409:     Token(rendered, TokenType.STRUCTURED, Map("json" -> true))
410:   }
411: 
412:   /**
413:    * Convenience overload that accepts a [[io.circe.Json]] value directly,
414:    * converting it to [[JsonValue]] internally before tokenizing.
415:    */
416:   def tokenize(json: CirceJson): Token = tokenize(JsonValue.fromCirce(json))
417: 
418:   /** Tokenize the value found at a dotted path inside the JSON tree. */
419:   def tokenizePath(value: JsonValue, path: String): Option[Token] = {
420:     val parts = path.split("\\.").toList
421:     val resolved: Option[JsonValue] =
422:       parts.foldLeft(Option[JsonValue](value)) {
423:         case (Some(JsonValue.JObject(fields)), part) if fields.contains(part) =>
424:           Some(fields(part))
425:         case (Some(JsonValue.JArray(items)), part) =>
426:           Try(part.toInt).toOption.flatMap { idx =>
427:             if (idx >= 0 && idx < items.size) Some(items(idx)) else None
428:           }
429:         case (Some(_), _) => None
430:         case (None, _)    => None
431:       }
432:     resolved.map(tokenize)
433:   }
434: 
435:   /** Circe-friendly overload that returns Option[Token] for a path inside a [[CirceJson]]. */
436:   def tokenizePath(json: CirceJson, path: String): Option[Token] =
437:     tokenizePath(JsonValue.fromCirce(json), path)
438: }

440: object JsonTokenizer {
441: 
442:   /** Render a [[JsonValue]] to a JSON-formatted String. */
443:   def render(value: JsonValue, pretty: Boolean): String = {
444:     val sb = new StringBuilder
445:     writeInto(sb, value, pretty, 0)
446:     sb.toString
447:   }
448: 
449:   private def writeInto(sb: StringBuilder, v: JsonValue, pretty: Boolean, indent: Int): Unit =
450:     v match {
451:       case JsonValue.JString(s) =>
452:         sb.append('"').append(escape(s)).append('"')
453:       case JsonValue.JNumber(n) =>
454:         sb.append(n.toString)
455:       case JsonValue.JBool(true) =>
456:         sb.append("true")
457:       case JsonValue.JBool(false) =>
458:         sb.append("false")
459:       case JsonValue.JNull =>
460:         sb.append("null")
461:       case JsonValue.JArray(items) =>
462:         sb.append('[')
463:         items.zipWithIndex.foreach { case (item, idx) =>
464:           if (idx > 0) sb.append(',')
465:           if (pretty) { sb.append('\n'); pad(sb, indent + 1) }
466:           writeInto(sb, item, pretty, indent + 1)
467:         }
468:         if (pretty && items.nonEmpty) { sb.append('\n'); pad(sb, indent) }
469:         sb.append(']')
470:       case JsonValue.JObject(fields) =>
471:         sb.append('{')
472:         val entries = fields.toList
473:         entries.zipWithIndex.foreach { case ((k, v), idx) =>
474:           if (idx > 0) sb.append(',')
475:           if (pretty) { sb.append('\n'); pad(sb, indent + 1) }
476:           sb.append('"').append(escape(k)).append("\":")
477:           if (pretty) sb.append(' ')
478:           writeInto(sb, v, pretty, indent + 1)
479:         }
480:         if (pretty && entries.nonEmpty) { sb.append('\n'); pad(sb, indent) }
481:         sb.append('}')
482:     }
483: 
484:   private def pad(sb: StringBuilder, level: Int): Unit = {
485:     var i = 0
486:     while (i < level) { sb.append("  "); i += 1 }
487:   }
488: 
489:   private def escape(s: String): String = {
490:     val sb = new StringBuilder(s.length + 2)
491:     s.foreach {
492:       case '"'  => sb.append("\\\"")
493:       case '\\' => sb.append("\\\\")
494:       case '\n' => sb.append("\\n")
495:       case '\r' => sb.append("\\r")
496:       case '\t' => sb.append("\\t")
497:       case c if c < ' ' => sb.append(f"\\u${c.toInt}%04x")
498:       case c    => sb.append(c)
499:     }
500:     sb.toString
501:   }
502: }

505: // WhitespaceTokenizer
506: // ============================================================================
507: 
508: /**
509:  * Splits text by whitespace and produces a list of [[Token]]s. Optionally
510:  * lowercases, strips punctuation, truncates by max length, and filters
511:  * tokens shorter than `minLength`.
512:  */
513: class WhitespaceTokenizer(
514:     lowercase: Boolean = false,
515:     minLength: Int = 0,
516:     maxLength: Option[Int] = None,
517:     stripPunctuation: Boolean = false
518: ) {
519: 
520:   private val punctuation: Set[Char] =
521:     Set('.', ',', '!', '?', ';', ':', '\'', '"', '(', ')', '[', ']', '{', '}')
522: 
523:   private def processToken(word: String): Option[String] = {
524:     val cleaned   = if (stripPunctuation) word.filterNot(punctuation.contains) else word
525:     val normalized = if (lowercase) cleaned.toLowerCase else cleaned
526: 
527:     if (normalized.length < minLength) None
528:     else if (normalized.isEmpty) None
529:     else maxLength match {
530:       case Some(max) if normalized.length > max => Some(normalized.take(max))
531:       case _                                    => Some(normalized)
532:     }
533:   }
534: 
535:   /** Split the input text on whitespace and return one Token per surviving word. */
536:   def tokenize(text: String): List[Token] =
537:     text.split("\\s+").iterator.zipWithIndex
538:       .flatMap { case (word, idx) =>
539:         processToken(word).map { processed =>
540:           Token(processed, TokenType.STRING, Map("position" -> idx, "original" -> word))
541:         }
542:       }
543:       .toList
544: 
545:   /** Convenience that returns only the string values of the produced tokens. */
546:   def tokenizeToStrings(text: String): List[String] = tokenize(text).map(_.value)
547: 
548:   /**
549:    * Tokenize text and report the (token-string, start-character, end-character)
550:    * of every surviving token.
551:    */
552:   def tokenizeWithPositions(text: String): List[(String, Int, Int)] = {
553:     var currentPos = 0
554:     val out        = mutable.ListBuffer.empty[(String, Int, Int)]
555:     text.split("\\s+").foreach { word =>
556:       val start = text.indexOf(word, currentPos)
557:       val end   = if (start < 0) currentPos else start + word.length
558:       processToken(word).foreach { processed => out += ((processed, start, end)) }
559:       currentPos = end
560:     }
561:     out.toList
562:   }
563: 
564:   /** The number of tokens the text would produce. */
565:   def countTokens(text: String): Int = tokenize(text).length
566: }

572: /**
573:  * Fluent builder for composing a tokenizer function from normalizers,
574:  * validators, and static metadata.
575:  */
576: final class TokenizerBuilder[T] {
577: 
578:   private val normalizers = mutable.ListBuffer.empty[String => String]
579:   private val validators  = mutable.ListBuffer.empty[T => Boolean]
580:   private val metadata    = mutable.Map.empty[String, Any]
581: 
582:   def withNormalizer(normalizer: String => String): this.type = {
583:     normalizers += normalizer
584:     this
585:   }
586: 
587:   def withValidator(validator: T => Boolean): this.type = {
588:     validators += validator
589:     this
590:   }
591: 
592:   def withMetadata(entries: (String, Any)*): this.type = {
593:     metadata ++= entries
594:     this
595:   }
596: 
597:   /** Produce the final `T => Token` function from the accumulated configuration. */
598:   def build(): T => Token = {
599:     val norms = normalizers.toList
600:     val vals  = validators.toList
601:     val meta  = metadata.toMap
602: 
603:     (value: T) => {
604:       vals.foreach { v =>
605:         if (!v(value))
606:           throw new IllegalArgumentException(s"Validation failed for $value")
607:       }
608:       val raw        = if (value == null) "null" else value.toString
609:       val normalized = norms.foldLeft(raw)((acc, n) => n(acc))
610:       Token(normalized, TokenType.STRING, meta)
611:     }
612:   }
613: }

616:   /** Construct an empty [[TokenizerBuilder]] for the given type parameter. */
